items.detail: The **Fed decides Wednesday** and is widely expected to hold, with futures pricing hold odds near **87%**, so the press conference matters more than the decision.
items.why: Hints of a December hike would hurt rate-sensitive tech, while calmer words could ease oil-driven rate fears.

items.detail: **Microsoft and Alphabet report Wednesday** after the close and **Amazon on Thursday**, the first megacap test since Meta's **7%** drop over AI spending.
items.why: Heavy capex without clear returns would deepen the Nasdaq's slide, while proof of AI revenue could halt it.

items.detail: Thursday morning brings **Q3 GDP** and **September core PCE**, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, with core forecast to rise **0.3%** on the month.
items.why: A hotter print the day after the Fed would revive hike bets and pressure both stocks and bonds.

items.detail: **SK hynix reports Wednesday** and **Samsung Thursday**, as MSCI's emerging-markets index tries to snap a **four-week losing streak** and Korea's Q3 GDP lands Tuesday.
items.why: Strong memory-chip outlooks could lift Korea and Taiwan, EM's heavyweights, even as oil hurts importers.

items.detail: **L&T and Maruti Suzuki report Tuesday** in a heavy Q2 week, with the **NIFTY 50** starting near **22,600** after last week's 2.4% fall.
items.why: Solid results could slow foreign selling, but Brent near $115 keeps pressure on India's import bill.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** heads into Wednesday's Fed decision after a **2%** weekly gain, while India's **NIFTY Smallcap 100** enters as the global laggard after a 7.3% drop.
items.why: Debt-heavy small caps need lower yields, so a hawkish Fed or hot PCE would hit them hardest.

items.detail: Bitcoin starts near **$80,500**, right around ETF buyers' **$81,300** average cost, with Wednesday's Fed and Big Tech results as the week's tests.
items.why: Staying below ETF buyers' cost could trigger more fund selling after Thursday's large outflow.

items.detail: Ether enters near **$2,400** with no upgrade catalyst after developers postponed Monday's Hoodi testnet upgrade, and its ETFs are on **four straight weeks** of outflows.
items.why: With no protocol news, ether trades on the Fed and tech mood, and fund outflows keep it lagging.

items.detail: Solana starts near **$103** in its first full week after the **Alpenglow upgrade** went live, with spot SOL ETF flows the gauge to watch.
items.why: The upgrade has not lifted the price yet, and renewed ETF buying would be the first sign it is working.

items.detail: Gold starts near **$4,010** an ounce, and **Wednesday's Fed decision**, followed by Thursday's PCE, decides whether its steepest weekly drop since June extends.
items.why: A hawkish Fed lifts yields and the dollar, which hurts gold, while softer guidance could revive buying.

crossCuttingTheme: Wednesday's Fed decision and Thursday's PCE meet Brent near $115: if oil-driven inflation keeps hike bets alive, higher yields hit AI megacaps, small caps, emerging markets, crypto and gold together.
